title: M3-PG media frame
description: A square-cornered, cropping frame for a photo or video, stretched to cover it. Empty, it is a flat pale-grey placeholder. Optionally the media zooms to 1.1 when a parent with group/media is hovered (0.4s ease).
notes: give the frame its size or aspect ratio through className
name: m3-pg-media

props.name: media
props.description: an or

props.name: zoom
props.description: zoom the media to 1.1 when a parent with the class group/media is hovered

props.name: className
props.description: size, aspect ratio and position of the frame
